summary: Host Digital Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a September 17, 2026 underwriting agreement with Cantor Fitzgerald for a firm-commitment follow-on offering of 2,187,500 Class A shares at $8.00 per share, roughly $17.5 million gross. The offering closed September 21, 2026, with a 30-day option for 328,125 additional shares. Proceeds are earmarked for data center investments, G&A, capital expenditures and working capital. The deal was executed off an existing Form S-3 shelf with preliminary and final prospectus supplements. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; the arbitrage angle is pricing pressure from the greenshoe overhang rather than an event.
